title: Sunshine Watersports PC
specs: Wild bottlenose dolphins commonly seen in St. Andrews Bay and near Shell Island
Tours include snorkeling, swimming, and shell collecting at Shell Island
Use of brand-new Yamaha WaveRunners for jet ski rentals and tours
Must be 16 or older or with parental consent for jet ski and dolphin tours
Valid photo ID required for all participants
Florida Boater Card required for anyone born after Jan 1, 1988; temporary cards available onsite
Weight limit 375 lbs per jet ski
Must be 18 or older with photo ID and credit card for pontoon rentals
Pontoon boats hold up to 10 passengers (1,600 lbs max)
Private boat tours available for families, small groups, birthdays, and special trips
includes: Life jackets and full safety briefing
Safety gear and fuel included with jet ski rentals
Coast Guard-approved life jackets, bimini top, anchor, map, full tank of fuel with pontoon rentals
Expert narration from friendly local captains on boat tours
Safety briefing and instruction before all tours and rentals
gap: Price for private boat tours not stated
blurb: Guests can pilot their own jet skis or relax on guided boat tours to see wild dolphins and explore Shell Island. Tours include snorkeling, swimming, and shell collecting opportunities. Safety briefings and life jackets are provided for all water activities.
extraNote: All tours and rentals are weather dependent; reschedule or refund if unsafe · Reservations required; spots fill up fast especially in summer · Safety is top priority; staff provides thorough instructions and safety gear · No glass containers allowed on pontoon boats · 312 Bay Shore Drive, Panama City Beach, FL
